summary: Repair P10 host rescan coverage-ledger module-axis mismatch so AlembicPlugin writes the same ProjectMap target-scoped coverage ledger axis as the Alembic in-process route.

targetTasks.summary: Fix the source defect shown by Test rerun after combined source repairs: host path now passes noPadding cleanup and reaches coverageLedgerSeed, and in-process moduleScope ["BiliDili"] now keeps nested targets, but parity remains blocked because host coverage_ledger writes aggregate/root module ids (BiliDili, Sources, Packages/*, root, module:root:*) while in-process writes ProjectMap target ids (target:*:*). First owner is AlembicPlugin: in lib/recipe-generation/host-agent-workflows/knowledge-rescan.ts, seedRescanCoverageLedgerFromSnapshot/buildRescanCoverageModules currently builds modules from projectContextAnalysis.moduleSeeds plus planGate.moduleBindings even though HostAgentProjectContextAnalysis carries presenterInput.map?.modules. Align host rescan coverage ledger modules with the ProjectMap target-scoped axis used by Alembic in-process KnowledgeRescanWorkflow, or return blocked with evidence that a shared Core/Alembic helper/export is required. Preserve existing recovered behavior: noPadding dataRoot cleanup, coverageLedgerSeed output metadata, provider handling, freeze values, and no manual BiliDili DB/source changes. Required evidence: code diff/commit, focused unit test reproducing host aggregate-vs-target axis and proving target:* module ids are written, affected build/check/lint, and boundary checks. Do not claim P10 real-test pass; Test must rerun real BiliDili after this source repair.
